title: GTA 6 Takes Your Money After Chapter 1? Save $5,000 First 💰 #Shorts
description:
Finishing Chapter 1 in GTA 6 wipes your pocket cash, your BuckMe checking balance and the floorboard stash. Only Family Savings survives: money there can't be withdrawn, but it can't be lost, and the first $5,000 goal raises your checking limit to $15,000. The mission Tourist Trap is the point of no return.

How much did you lose? Comment below.

Sources: GTABase (Tourist Trap mission guide), Player.One ("GTA 6 Money Warning", Nov 25, 2026, citing AllThingsHow), VGC (Tourist Trap walkthrough).
